objectives.description: Explain the importance of livestock farming to food security, income generation, and the Nigerian economy
Identify common livestock species farmed in Nigeria (cattle, goats, sheep, pigs, poultry, rabbits) and their uses
Describe the characteristics and products of different livestock species
Describe systems of livestock production: extensive, semi-intensive, and intensive farming systems
Describe the nutritional requirements of common livestock and identify types of livestock feed and feeding methods
Design and describe appropriate housing structures for different livestock species
Explain principles of livestock breeding including selection, mating systems, and record keeping
Describe the reproductive cycles and gestation periods of common farm animals
Apply good husbandry practices including water provision, sanitation, and environmental management
Identify common livestock diseases (Newcastle disease, foot-and-mouth disease, coccidiosis) and their symptoms
Describe methods of disease prevention including vaccination, biosecurity, and deworming schedules
Apply basic first aid treatment for minor livestock injuries and describe when to seek veterinary assistance
Describe ectoparasites and endoparasites affecting livestock and methods of control
Keep simple livestock farm records including production data, expenses, and income
Describe the value chain in livestock farming from production to processing and marketing
Identify business opportunities in livestock farming including poultry, snail farming, and fish farming
Write a simple farm business plan for a small-scale livestock enterprise
